name: Microgrid inverter fleet availability aggregator
summary: Combines the declared health and capability of the assigned renewable inverter group.
description: Combines the declared health and capability of the assigned renewable inverter group. Renewable-generation coordination connects variable resource availability, inverter operating limits and the microgrid power target. Available solar or wind power, an issued curtailment request and actual delivered power are different signals.

In a microgrid with solar generation, the controller can restrain inverter output when local load and storage cannot absorb the available power. The resource controller reports its own availability and accepted operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Individual inverter states” at the input and “Fleet operating capability” at the output. Shared feeder limits can reduce aggregate capability.
